jobs_results.title: BACKEND DEVELOPER (Laravel)
jobs_results.description:
Acierto.com, which is part of the Bauer Media Group, is the main insurance/financial comparator in Spain. Our mission is to help people save time and money in their household financial decisions. With more than 14 years of experience in the sector, our team is made up of more than 250 people. We provide information on the best insurance and banking products to more than 40,000 daily users.

We lead innovation in our sector thanks to the technology developed by our professionals. We are on a journey to grow and you have the chance to play a key role in it. Would you like to join us?

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

A PHP Ninja - Backend Developer who has a huge experience as +5 years.

A decisive person with the ability to integrate into innovation-oriented teams to face the new challenges that the market and customers throw at us.

Going into more detail, we need someone who has the following technical and personal skills to make the project grow.

We require:
• Solid hands-on with... developing web applications
• Strong aptitudes in OOP/SOLID/DRY principles
• Strong knowledge of PHP (Yii / Laravel is a Plus) and SQL (MySQL)
• Knowledge of TDD / DDD / BDD practices
• Knowledge of Relational & Non-Relational Databases / Document Databases.
• Familiar with LAMP environments, CI/CD practices, Git versioning system.
• Strong communication skills
• Good command of English

Nice to haves:
• Experience in Agile/SAFe methodologies
• Experience with Redis / NoSQL (MongoDB)
• Experience in ES6/Typescript / NodeJS / GraphQL
• Familiar with Headless architecture
• Knowledge of AWS services

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

You would support the development team in the migration of current applications to new business models/architecture.

You would be part of a constantly growing development team that handles internal and client development projects.

With your developments you would help our clients save money by applying to the best products for their personal finances (insurances, loans, mortgages,...).

WHAT WE OFFER?
• Permanent contract.
• Social benefits (medical insurance, transportation and ticket restaurants under flexible remuneration).
• Competitive salary according to value of the best candidate.
• Flexible hours and possibility of remote work.
• Friday afternoons off and summer schedule in August.
• Excellent work environment and professional project.
• Be part of an international group (Bauer Media Group OCP) where you can get and share knowledge and experiences.

LANGUAGES:
• You are fluent in Spanish and English.

LOCATION:
• Madrid o Barcelona

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Exciting opportunity for a Senior Backend Engineer with experience in supporting multiple teams to join a mobile games studio based in Barcelona working on innovative and ambitious mobile games! Great opportunity to join a young studio to be a core part of the studio's future successes'

This hybrid position necessitates a minimum of 4 years' industry experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Utilize your extensive expertise in game backend systems to support multiple development teams in creating engaging game elements.
• Create game infrastructures using platforms like PlayFab, AWS, or Azure, ensuring smooth integration and optimal performance.
• Design various gameplay elements such as leaderboards, live events, season passes, level progression, crafting, shops, and in-app purchases.
• Ability to write efficient and maintainable code
• Devise and implement new services according to stakeholder priorities.

REQUIREMENTS:
• 4+ years of games industry experience, with... proficiency in mobile development and frameworks such as Playfab.
• Genuine passion for making and playing mobile games
• Strong problem-solving skills and commitment to collaboration.
• Experience in SignalR, AWS, Azure functions, Redis, Jenkins, DataDog, Kibana, GitHub actions

Desired Skills:
• A keen interest in Mobile Games
• Multiplayer game development experience, including dedicated servers, replication, and client prediction.

How to Apply:

If you are a Senior Backend Engineer looking to be pat of an ambitious team, please submit your resume to fiona@eleven-eleven.io or contact me at 07305 324791

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer (all genders)
jobs_results.description:
Your mission
• Design and implement complex and scalable web applications in the areas of Ecommerce, PIM, CMS
• Integrate component-based front-ends developed by your colleagues
• Improve and extend existing solutions
• Create automated deployment solutions, reusable packages and test
• Code with design principles in mind. OOP, SOLID, DRY are important to us.
• Optimize technical processes together with your colleagues from different departments

Your profile
• 3+ years of experience in the development and maintenance of PHP-based web applications, ideally with Symfony or other frameworks
• Experience with Ecommerce and CMS systems
• Sound database knowledge (MySQL / NoSQL)
• Knowledge in the creation of APIs (REST / GraphQL)
• Experience with search engines like Elasticsearch or Apache Solr desirable
• Experience with scalable applications, cloud hosting, DevOps skills, and Kubernetes are a plus
• Confident in the use of Git
• Solution-oriented approach, reliability, strong... willingness to learn, and technical grasp
• Openness, ability to communicate and work in a team
• Excellent English skills

Why us?
• A dynamic and demanding agency environment with multiple challenges and an interesting client mix
• Working in an agile and focused team
• Varied and independent tasks with flat hierarchies and mutual trust
• A permanent employment contract with the choice of hybrid or full remote within Germany, Spain or Austria
• Locations in Munich, Traunstein, Barcelona and Vienna
• Flexible working hours (child-friendly and without weekend duty)
• Legendary team events

About Us

We are the digital agency with a full-service-character with offices in Munich, Traunstein, Barcelona and Vienna. Since 2007, we have been conceiving, designing and programming individual website projects, creating sophisticated designs, developing successful advertising campaigns and much more for our clients. We not only offer individual solutions for our customers - our team also benefits from this. We have professionals working in the areas of web development, design, marketing and consulting

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Ever since 2012, Avature has been growing at a 50% annual rate, resulting in an exciting work environment, full of technical challenges and learning opportunities. Our Software Engineers play the lead in this journey, using their analytical and technical skills (and above all, their enthusiasm) to tackle the complex problems of a feature-rich yet user friendly enterprise application, driving forward the growth of a product used by thousands of users every day.

Your challenges and objectives:
• Gain knowledge of our platform by understanding the complex interaction of a wide range of areas and services, from network layer to final user.
• Work on a product that involves several computer science areas, such as highly available and performant systems, top-notch security standards, and intuitive user interface design.
• Help us build a highly flexible platform which allows users to customize it through tailored configurations and UI options.
• Learn, collaborate with different teams and... grow while tackling complex technical challenges in a fun and encouraging working environment.

Your day-to-day activities:
• Work with the Product Team on functional specifications of features (specs): interpret and analyze, but also give feedback for them.
• Design and write the code for the feature.
• Perform technical analysis of existing code and perform refactors to improve code quality.
• Perform code review.
• Learn and apply best practices during the entire development process, from the very early stages of technical analysis and design of solutions, to the monitoring in production.

About you:
• Bachelor degree in Computer Science (in progress or complete) or equivalent experience.
• Superior analytical/troubleshooting skills.
• Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis.
• Background or interest in one or more of these: PHP, JavaScript, Java, C++, Python.
• Interest in Unix, preferably Linux.

About us:

Avature is a market leading enterprise SaaS Solution provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the very large company market. We currently work with over 650 companies worldwide, including 110 of the Fortune 500, all of the Big Four consulting firms, the largest banks and manufactures in the world, and five governments.

We design, build, implement and support our product ourselves. With 26 releases a year and a strong commitment to innovation and quality engineering, our private cloud platform has become the product choice for the very large global organization.

At Avature we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We offer a career development program that supports continuous learning, thoughtful leadership, and meaningfully impacts each individual’s professional trajectory.

What we offer:
• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.
• Flexible hours and possibility to work from home.
• Four salary reviews per year.
• Option to earn part of your salary in US dollars.
• Three weeks vacations from the first year.
• Four weeks paternity leave.
• OSDE 310 health coverage (family plan).
• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.
• Internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it’s a pathway for creating a more equal society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment, and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promote equal opportunities within our organization

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend Python
jobs_results.description:
🌟 Sobre Nosotros

Somos una startup que desarrolla soluciones innovadoras de Visión Artificial, enfocándonos en el sector del retail. Nuestras soluciones permiten mejorar el proceso de compra en supermercados mediante la detección de productos en diversos entornos. Como parte de nuestro equipo, contribuirás al desarrollo de tecnología punta, basada en Inteligencia Artificial y aquí, encontrarás un ambiente flexible, dedicado y orientado a la resolución creativa de problemas.

🚀 Rol

Estamos buscando un Desarrollador Backend Python con experiencia a ser posible con tarjetas tipo Raspberry, para unirse a nuestro equipo de tecnología. En este rol, trabajarás en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de nuestras soluciones de software, jugando un papel crucial en nuestra misión de transformar el sector retail.

Este puesto ofrece la oportunidad de trabajar en un entorno híbrido, con la flexibilidad de trabajar desde casa, aunque será necesario estar algunos dias en nuestra oficina en Bilbao... debido al trabajo con equipos físicos.

🏢 Trabajando en Nuestra Empresa:

En nuestra empresa, creemos en dar a nuestros empleados la flexibilidad y libertad para aportar sus ideas. Te ofrecemos la oportunidad de ser parte de un equipo innovador, trabajando en tecnologías avanzadas con muchas oportunidades para aprender y crecer.

🔑 Responsabilidades Clave

· Desarrollo y mantenimiento de software en Python.

· Colaboración estrecha con otros equipos para implementar soluciones efectivas.

· Contribuir a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos y tecnologías.

· Trabajo con Raspberry Pi u otras tarjetas de desarrollo.

📜 Calificaciones

· Experiencia sólida en programación Python.

· Experiencia trabajando con Raspberry Pi o tarjetas similares.

· Habilidades fuertes de resolución de problemas y pensamiento crítico.

💼 Lo que Ofrecemos

· Salario competitivo.

· Desarrollo profesional en tecnologías puntas como Inteligencia y Visión Artificial

· Oportunidad de trabajar con un equipo diverso y talentoso.

· Ser parte de una industria en rápida evolución.

✉️ Cómo Aplicar

¡Si eres apasionado por la tecnología y estás listo para dejar tu huella en la industria del retail, nos encantaría saber de ti! Aplica a través de LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Wincom is a software development company working in the field of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM). We extend one of the most used PLM software to adjust it to our customer s needs. We work directly for the major manufacturing companies in the world from luxury goods to aerospace and several of our customers are in the Fortune 500. For the past 10 years we have extended our footprint to over 120 customers in 16 countries.

What makes us unique? We think out-of-the-box We have created a unique and innovative architecture that allow us to build deploy and support software in a lean agile and secure way that is making us a reference in our sector.

If you are looking to grow your technical skills and learn coding best practices based on the latest techniques and concepts come work with us! We offer an excellent learning environment where you will be fully trained to gain differentiating expertise. You will also improve your soft skills by working with a cross-functional team (QA Support... Sales) and interacting directly with customers.

The position

We are looking for a full-time Backend Developer with or without experience. The salary is between 25 000 30 000 .

Responsabilities

Participate in the whole lifecycle of applications from development to maintenance.

Enhance existing software portfolio.

Interact with other developers to integrate developed software.

Interact with the end customer and/or the main contractors.

Issue resolution you will support customers that report issues on their products in coordination with the QA and Support team.

Testing and optimization

Support presales activities

Report to the project manager and/or the technical leads

MUST HAVE TECHNICAL BACKGROUND

Good knowledge of Linux and Windows

Java and Object-Oriented development

JavaScript

Understanding of Source Control Management (Subversion Git)

Maven

IDE (NetBeans and or Eclipse)

NICE TO HAVE TECHNICAL BACKGROUND

Knowledge of database (Oracle MS SQL).

Java standards and libraries (JAXB Spring Thymleaf...)

Knowledge of W3C standards (XML XSD HTML etc....)

Javascript Libraries/Frameworks such as JQuery REACT Angular....

Knowledge Libraries/Frameworks IT administration is a plus.

Your Skills

Fluent English both spoken and written as it is the language used in the company is a must-have.

High analytical capacity and motivation for technically challenging problems

Good communication clear and concise reporting

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Continuous training

Private medical and dental insurance

Offices in the very center of Barcelona

Spanish / English classes with experienced teacher

Bonus program

Linux, Java, JavaScript, Maven, NetBeans, Eclipse , Oracle, SQL, JAXB, Spring, W3C, XML, XSD, HTML, Javascript

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect is an established company with a start-up culture seeking creative entrepreneurial people like you to join our team. We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products.

About TransPerfect:

TransPerfect helps organizations navigate the global marketplace. It remains founder-led – and has striven to maintain the ethos and drive that led them to grow organically year-on-year for the past 30 years. Starting in an NYU dorm room in the early 1990s, TransPerfect is now recognized as the largest translation and language services company in the world. From offices in more than 90 cities on six continents, TransPerfect offers a full range of services in 170+ languages to clients worldwide.

You will be part of a technology department that is comprised of a successful and multidisciplinary group of professionals located across the globe – Barcelona, New York, London, Manchester... Bucharest and India. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

About the team you will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.

To learn more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:
• Engage in all phases of application development, with a focus on coding and debugging in alignment with security standards throughout the entire lifecycle
• Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code/APIs to support applications both for web and mobile
• Collaborate regularly in a cross-functional team made up of product managers, quality assurance teams, designers and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address issues
• Optimize web applications for performance, scalability and security
• Implement security best practices to safeguard sensitive data and protect against potential threats
• Develop automation tests/ collaborate with automation engineers to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing
• Work closely with users to provide personalized software support as needed
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our backend infrastructure
• Document application support and operational procedures
• Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to foster their growth and development

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on building scalable and reliable systems
• Extensive knowledge of C#, LINQ, MS SQL, Entity Framework and related technologies
• Capable to use version control software such as GIT
• Knowledge of SOLID principles
• Knowledge of clean code practices
• Experience using web service protocols such as Rest, API design for extensibility and integration
• Experience debugging complex applications
• Experience with Agile development project management methodologies
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Experience with Azure or AWS is a plus

Why TransPerfect:

For 30 years, we have honed a culture where all kinds of ideas are shared and new ventures are not only welcomed, but also encouraged. In this fast-paced environment, employees are intellectually stimulated so they can grow alongside the organization. From Intern to President, we believe that every single employee should have a voice and contribute to the amazing services we offer our clients.

We also offer:
• A dynamic, well-functioning software development division with the world's largest provider of language services and technology solutions
• Significant room for growth and creative opportunities
• A healthy work-life balance, prioritized and encouraged by your team
• An overwhelming preference for promoting internally
• An opportunity to have real impact in product direction and development

Work model:

This position is intended to be largely in-office with a focus on flexibility. Today, most of the global team is on a hybrid model ranging between 3-4 days in the office per week. We aim to find an inclusive balance between everyone's personal lives and responsibilities and the value created from in-office collaboration. We work with new team members to find that balance with them while building the trust and collaboration that our team values.

We believe that sharing the same physical space with our colleagues creates a level of trust and understanding that fosters innovation and a sense of purpose.

The socializing and relationships formed from these in-person interactions have created the bonds that make our team successful.

We not only want to encourage people to safely spend time in the office, but also, schedule regular travel between our offices in Europe and the US – and a regular conference where the entire worldwide team is gathered together. Maybe the Metaverse will replace the office some day – but it hasn't yet! Online meetings were a powerful connector during the pandemic – but they don't foster the same connection.

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

¿Te apasiona la informática y ya tienes experiencia en desarrollo? 💻

Puede que esta sea tu oportunidad de comenzar una carrera profesional en ASG -SI del Grupo Tier1 que está ubicada en Madrid

¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Programador/a Oracle especializado en PL/SQL y Java!

🚀En ASG del Grupo Tier1 podrás vivir muchas experiencias y hacer parte de un equipo profesional cohesionado que siempre estarán dispuesto ayudarte y no pararas de aprender y seguir creciendo profesionalmente.

Estarás en rodeado/a de personas motivadas en un ambiente muy bueno donde el equipo te echará una mano siempre que necesites.

Si tienes al menos dos años de experiencia trabajando con PL/SQL y bases de datos Oracle, así como también en Java y Spring Boot, ⌨️

¡queremos conocerte!🔍

✍🏼 ¿Qué buscamos?
• Experiencia mínima de dos años con PL/SQL y base de datos Oracle, incluyendo trabajo con vistas complejas, JSON, XML, procedimientos, tablas temporales, entre otros.
• Experiencia sólida en Java y Spring... Boot, con conocimiento en frameworks como Spring Core, Security, Spring JPA Hibernate, JPA, Batch, Log4j/SLF4J.
• Dominio de Java 8, 11 y 17.
• Experiencia en el manejo de repositorios de código GIT.
• Conocimientos en servicios REST/SOAP.
• Experiencia en la documentación de API's con OpenAPI/Swagger.

• Conocimientos en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web con Angular 2.
• Familiaridad con el desarrollo y lanzamiento de aplicaciones Android e IOS mediante tecnologías híbridas como IONIC y Flutter.
• Experiencia en el uso de Jira.

En ASG ofrecemos un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo, oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y proyectos desafiantes que te permitirán seguir desarrollando tus habilidades.

¡postúlate ahora y únete a nosotros en esta emocionante aventura!

jobs_results.title: .NET Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Resumen del puesto

Empresa líder sector retail precisa incorporar el rol de Backend .NET Developer.

Descripción del puesto de trabajo
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener APIs Web eficientes y escalables utilizando el framework .NET.
• Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de desarrollo para comprender los requisitos del proyecto y garantizar la entrega oportuna de soluciones de alta calidad.
• Participar en la planificación y diseño de arquitecturas de software, asegurando la adherencia a las mejores prácticas y estándares de la industria.
• Optimizar el rendimiento y la eficiencia de las aplicaciones existentes mediante la identificación y resolución de cuellos de botella y problemas de escalabilidad.
• Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y metodologías para mejorar continuamente los procesos de desarrollo.
• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios, incluyendo desarrolladores frontend, QA y otros stakeholders, para garantizar la integración efectiva de los... sistemas.
• Documentar claramente el código desarrollado y participar en revisiones de código para garantizar la calidad y la consistencia del mismo.
• Brindar soporte técnico y solucionar problemas relacionados con aplicaciones existentes en producción.

Perfil buscado (H/M/D)
• Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo de aplicaciones backend utilizando el framework .NET (C#).
• Conocimiento sólido de la creación y consumo de APIs RESTful.
• Familiaridad con frameworks y tecnologías relacionadas, como ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, LINQ, etc.
• Experiencia en el diseño y mantenimiento de bases de datos relacionales (preferiblemente SQL Server).
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y en equipo, demostrando excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración.
• Experiencia en metodologías ágiles de desarrollo de software (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).
• Actitud proactiva hacia el aprendizaje continuo y la mejora personal y profesional.
• Buena comprensión de los principios de seguridad de la información y las mejores prácticas de codificación segura.

Siguientes pasos

Si estás interesado en esta oferta, haz click en "aplicar ahora" para enviar una copia actualizada de tu CV, o llámanos ahora.

Si esta oferta no se adapta a tu perfil pero estás buscando un nuevo puesto de trabajo, por favor contáctanos y lo comentamos. Garantizamos la confidencialidad
